data.title: "Miami Vice" Casting Call for Classic Cars

opportunity.title: "Miami Vice" Casting Call for Classic Cars
opportunity.roles: The upcoming “Miami Vice” movie is seeking classic car owners in Miami and Fort Lauderdale, Florida, for an exciting feature film production. Casting TaylorMade is looking for vintage vehicles manufactured between 1977 and 1989 to appear in scenes that capture the iconic atmosphere of Miami during the 1980s. Convertibles, muscle cars, luxury cruisers, and everyday classic vehicles are all encouraged to apply. This classic car casting opportunity is perfect for vehicle owners interested in having their cars featured on screen in a major Hollywood production.
opportunity.compensation: details will be discussed with selected vehicle owners.
opportunity.eligibility: Classic car owners with vehicles manufactured between 1977 and 1989. Convertibles, muscle cars, luxury cruisers, and everyday vintage automobiles are welcome. Vehicles should reflect the appearance and style of the late 1970s and 1980s. Must be based in or able to bring the vehicle to Miami or Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Vehicles should be in suitable working and visual condition for filming. Owners must be available during the production’s filming schedule. Ability to follow production guidelines regarding vehicle placement and use.
opportunity.submission_instructions: Apply via the listing's Apply Now button / application form on projectcasting.com.
opportunity.verification_notes: Project Casting aggregator listing; original source not named on the listing page — trace to original before VERIFIED status. Employer named on listing: Casting TaylorMade (Miami). Listing validThrough (expiry) 2026-11-27T00:00 per JobPosting data. Posted 2026-10-28 per JobPosting data.
